name: TV set-top boxes
label: TV set-top box

modes.title: Boxes stuck on the start screen
modes.symptom: boxes freezing on the start-up logo
customer_says: My TV box won't start. It sits on the Meridian logo and never gets any further.
The set-top box is stuck on the loading screen. I've left it an hour and nothing has changed.
Our box froze during the night, and now it only shows the welcome picture.
The TV box powers on, shows the logo, and that's it. No menu, no channels.

causes.cause: a damaged software image sent out in the nightly update
fixes: sending a clean software image to the boxes

causes.cause: an activation server refusing box check-ins
a boot loader setting changed by a remote diagnostics job

workarounds: watch live channels through the aerial input on the television
use the Meridian TV app on a phone or tablet until the box recovers
aftercare: leave the box plugged in for thirty minutes while it completes its update
hold the power button for ten seconds if the box has not restarted by itself

modes.title: Programme guide empty
modes.symptom: the programme guide showing no information
customer_says: The guide on my TV box is blank. Every channel just says no information.
I can't see what's on. The programme guide has no listings in it at all.
Our box plays channels, but the guide is empty, so I can't set anything to record.
The TV guide shows to be announced for every programme, for the whole week.

causes.cause: a schedule data feed that stopped arriving from the listings supplier
fixes: reloading the schedule data feed from the supplier's backup

causes.cause: a guide database index that became corrupted
a carousel server sending an empty schedule
fixes: restarting the carousel server with a full schedule

workarounds: check listings in the Meridian TV app, which uses a separate guide
set recordings by time and channel using the manual recording screen
aftercare: leave the box in standby overnight so that the guide can refill
check that any series recordings are still listed

modes.title: Recordings failing
customer_says: My box has stopped recording. Everything I set shows as failed the next morning.
None of my series links are recording. The planner is full of red crosses.
I set the box to record a film earlier and it didn't even start.
Recordings aren't working on our TV box. Live TV is fine, but nothing gets saved.

causes.cause: a recording rights flag set wrongly on every channel
a time signal fault that put the boxes' clocks an hour out
fixes: repairing the time signal sent to the boxes

causes.cause: a planner service outage in the cloud recording platform

workarounds: watch missed programmes on catch-up from the on demand menu
start recordings by hand with the record button while the programme is on
aftercare: open the planner and set up again any recording marked as failed
check that the clock on the box shows the right time

modes.title: Picture breaking up
modes.symptom: pictures breaking into blocks on live channels
customer_says: The picture on my TV box keeps breaking up into little squares, and the sound cuts out with it.
Live channels are freezing and going blocky on our box. It is on every channel.
The telly picture keeps pixelating. It is fine for a minute and then it falls apart.
We're getting a broken, stuttering picture on the set-top box, and the sound jumps.

causes.cause: a failing encoder at the regional head-end
fixes: replacing the failing encoder at the head-end

causes.cause: packet loss on the multicast video network
fixes: re-routing the multicast video network around the lossy link

causes.cause: a wrong signal level set on the distribution amplifiers
fixes: resetting the signal level on the distribution amplifiers

workarounds: switch to the standard definition version of the channel
watch the programme through the on demand menu instead of live
aftercare: restart the box to clear any stuck picture
switch back to the high definition channels

wrong_customer_side: a loose aerial lead at the back of the box
a remote control with flat batteries
wrong_provider_side: a transmitter fault affecting the whole area
engineering work on the broadcast tower
high pressure weather interfering with reception
a change of channel numbers this week
